preparation.scope: Current cooperative32 fixed batch kernel versus four items x16 columns with GRF128 or GRF256, and a separate cooperative32 first-four-state-rows prefetch before history work. preparation.rule_before_measurement: Three fixed candidates, 85 checks each. One shape-local A/B/A/B/A screen; select one candidate passing BOTH capacities by combined geometric throughput, then two fresh confirmation processes. Each positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift <=3%) and positive pooled gain; each capacity geometric throughput gain >=1% in screen and confirmation. No resampling or model-speedup claim. An eligible winner is cleaned up and independently rebuilt for another screen/two confirmations plus existing GDN regression and native audit before source adoption.
